name: Creamy Avocado-Yogurt Dip with Bell Pepper "Chips"
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and add to the bowl. Season with spices and mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
Add yogurt to the bowl and stir to combine the avocado-yogurt dip. Set aside.
Cut bell peppers lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Slice each quarter crosswise into 3-4 pieces to make the "chips."
To serve, divide dip and bell pepper "chips" between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
